name: osusume
description: Osusume — self-hosted anime recommendations from your AniList list — deterministic taste profile, local LLM explanations, hidden gems, franchise-aware.

scripts.dist:mac: pnpm build && pnpm build:pyserver && pnpm build:electron && electron-builder --mac

scripts.dist:linux: pnpm build && pnpm build:pyserver && pnpm build:electron && electron-builder --linux
